notes: Fuel: CORINE 2018 classes mapped to FuelClass (312 conifer -> TimberLitter, 311/313 -> TimberUnderstory, 32x/334 -> Shrub, 2xx -> Agriculture, 321/333 -> Grass). CLC 112 (discontinuous urban: Mati, Neos Voutzas, Kokkino Limanaki) is a WUI mix: cells with an OSM building centroid within one cell (3x3, ~60 m block) -> Urban (1264 ha), the rest -> TimberLitter (pine between houses, 3631 ha). Sea from the elevation mask plus CORINE 523.

Arrival raster (synthesized): Dijkstra travel time from the ignition over the 8-neighbour grid, restricted to the real EFFIS burnt-area polygon (cells outside never burn), with fuel rate (CORINE-derived), slope factor and a fixed WNW wind (275 deg) anisotropy. Model time is mapped to clock time piecewise-linearly through documented anchors: ignition 16:41, first-house 16:46, two-fingers 17:21, nv-west-edge 17:41, neos-voutzas 18:02, marathonos 18:19, coast 18:45 EEST; perimeter anchors use the IAWF perimeter lengths. After the coast anchor flank cells burn at 1/1.8 of the last segment rate (last cell 19:31 EEST). Ember spotting, which the sources describe, is not modelled.
